control_center_embedded_authorization_ma.discovery: A prior live inspection found shared authorization material embedded in Control Center workflow code.
required_remediation_sequence: identify the runtime workflow and all callers
move the value into appropriate n8n credential or secret storage
remove any fallback or embedded value
certify that the old value is no longer accepted
scan related workflows for residual embedded material
workspace_boundary: the secret value is never reproduced, searched for, or stored in this repository
no production n8n mutation was attempted
certification is explicitly handed back to the canonical Forgejo/n8n integration agent
